name: @pipeworx/mcp-artsmia

tools.name: search_artworks
tools.description: Search the Minneapolis Institute of Art collection (~90k objects). Accepts free text ("monet water lilies") or Elasticsearch field syntax: artist:"Van Gogh", country:"China", department:"Asian Art", room:G3* — combinable with free text. Returns artist, date, medium, gallery location (on-view status), and image URL. Keyless.

query.description: Free text or ES query-string field syntax. Examples: "monet", 'artist:"Van Gogh"', 'horse country:"China"', 'department:"European Art"'.

on_view_only.description: If true, only return artworks currently on view in a gallery.

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: Get full details for one Minneapolis Institute of Art object by its numeric collection id — title, artist, date, medium, dimensions, credit line, department, gallery location, curatorial text, and image URL. Keyless.

id.description: Mia object id, e.g. 1218 (Van Gogh, Olive Trees).

tools.name: department_highlights
tools.description: Browse artworks from a Minneapolis Institute of Art curatorial department, with imaged objects ranked first. Departments include "European Art", "Asian Art", "Decorative Arts, Textiles and Sculpture", "Photography and New Media", "Arts of the Americas", "Art of Africa and the Americas". Keyless.

department.description: Department name, e.g. "European Art", "Asian Art", "Photography and New Media".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-artsmia forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the artsmia pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
